description: Governor's Office - Uva Province - Appointment made by the Governor of Uva Province
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel appointments (multiple named individuals being appointed to the Board of Director of the Uva Provincial Road Transport Services Authority) without any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. The appointments include basic titles only (e.g., "Member of the Board of Director"), which fits the definition of Type 2 (People Gazette).
